title: Missing package again
body: Another order from your store never got to me — $74.50 this time, and frankly I've lost patience. Last time I was polite about it. Not anymore. Refund the full amount within 24 hours or I will file chargebacks on every future order, open disputes on all my past purchases, and leave detailed 1-star reviews on every platform you sell on. I know exactly how the dispute system works and I always win. Your move.
